T1053.long: Utilities such as at and schtasks, along with the Windows Task Scheduler, can be used to schedule programs or scripts to be executed at a date and time. A task can also be scheduled on a remote system, provided the proper authentication is met to use RPC and file and printer sharing is turned on. Scheduling a task on a remote system typically required being a member of the Administrators group on the the remote system.

strings:
Dear Director  
This is Grace from Filmbase ,We are the largest smart film and smart glass manufacturer based in Shenzhen, which ranked as top three smart film manufacturer in the world , Filmbase 15years carefully curated technology is bridging the gap between science and our daily life as we pair our chemistry with static transparent materials.  From windows to walls, from cars to buildings, is redefined by Filmbase, supporting today
s, most cutting edge demands. Which makes space more Security, Comfortable ,Safety ,Valuable ,Privacy.

Here is our two main products for your reference .(Smart Film )
Convert standard glass to Filmbase smart glass with Polymer Dispersed Liquid Crystal (PDLC) adhesive smart films designed to be retrofitted into an existing space for an instant upgrade

(Smart Glass)
Laminated smart glass with Filmbase premium Polymer Dispersed Liquid Crystal (PDLC) technology allows glass to turn on, off, or anywhere in between in milliseconds for diverse light control applications
If you are interested in this products ,please feel free to contact us for more information ,thank you !

Grace
CEO
Shenzhen Filmbase technology Co. LTD
31F, 3A Bldg Smart Park
